title: Regional Sales and Margin
question: Which regions turn sales into profit most efficiently?
sql: SELECT region AS dimension, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

title: Category Profit Contribution
question: How much profit does each category contribute?
sql: SELECT category AS dimension, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

title: Subcategory Loss Exposure
question: Which subcategories have negative profit and concentrated losses?
sql: SELECT sub_category AS dimension, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY sub_category ORDER BY sub_category

title: Monthly Sales and Profit
question: How do sales and profit evolve across all 48 observed months?
sql: SELECT order_month AS dimension, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month

title: Customer Segment Economics
question: Which customer segments offer stronger sales and margins?
sql: SELECT segment AS dimension, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment

title: State Profitability Review
question: Which states merit a detailed loss review?
sql: SELECT state AS dimension, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY state ORDER BY state

title: Shipping Mode Sales Mix
question: How do sales and profit differ by shipping mode, without implying delivery performance?
sql: SELECT ship_mode AS dimension, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY ship_mode ORDER BY ship_mode

title: Discount Band Economics
question: How are discount bands associated with line-level profitability?
sql: SELECT discount_band AS dimension, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY discount_band ORDER BY discount_band

title: Annual Commercial Performance
question: How did annual sales and profit change during the observed period?
sql: SELECT order_year AS dimension, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year

title: Quarterly Trading Review
question: What quarterly pattern is visible in sales and margins?
sql: SELECT order_quarter AS dimension, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY order_quarter ORDER BY order_quarter

title: Order Value and Basket Size
question: What is the true average order value after consolidating order lines?
sql: SELECT order_id,COUNT(*) AS lines,SUM(quantity) AS units,SUM(sales) AS order_sales,SUM(profit) AS order_profit FROM superstore GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_sales DESC

title: Customer Observed Value
question: Which customers generated the most observed revenue, not projected lifetime value?
sql: SELECT customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,SUM(sales) AS observed_sales,SUM(profit) AS observed_profit,MIN(order_date) AS first_order,MAX(order_date) AS last_order FROM superstore GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY observed_sales DESC

title: Year over Year Sales Growth
question: What is annual sales growth with a missing first-year comparison?
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_year,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit FROM superstore GROUP BY order_year), b AS (SELECT *,LAG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY order_year) AS prior_sales FROM a) SELECT *,sales/NULLIF(prior_sales,0)-1 AS yoy_growth FROM b ORDER BY order_year

title: State Rank within Region
question: Which states lead sales within each region?
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT region,state,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit FROM superstore GROUP BY region,state) SELECT *,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sales DESC) AS regional_rank FROM a ORDER BY region,regional_rank

title: Rolling Three Month Sales
question: What is the trailing three-month sales baseline without partial initial windows?
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_month,SUM(sales) AS sales FROM superstore GROUP BY order_month) SELECT *,CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY order_month)>=3 THEN AVG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY order_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) END AS trailing_3_month_sales FROM a ORDER BY order_month

title: Product Sales Concentration
question: How concentrated is revenue across products?
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(sales) AS sales FROM superstore GROUP BY product_id) SELECT *,SUM(sales) OVER(ORDER BY sales DESC,product_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)/SUM(sales) OVER() AS cumulative_share FROM a ORDER BY sales DESC,product_id

title: First Observed Purchase Cohorts
question: How many customers and sales belong to each first-observed annual cohort?
sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(order_year) AS cohort FROM superstore GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT f.cohort,COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS customers,COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS orders,SUM(s.sales) AS sales FROM superstore s JOIN firsts f USING(customer_id) GROUP BY f.cohort ORDER BY f.cohort

title: Order Level Shipping Intervals
question: What are dispatch intervals by shipping mode when orders are counted once?
sql: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id,ship_mode,MAX(ship_days) AS days FROM superstore GROUP BY order_id,ship_mode) SELECT ship_mode,COUNT(*) AS orders,AVG(days) AS mean_days,MIN(days) AS min_days,MAX(days) AS max_days FROM o GROUP BY ship_mode ORDER BY mean_days

title: Loss Making Order Audit
question: Which orders lose money overall rather than only on individual lines?
sql: SELECT order_id,customer_id,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit,SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY order_id,customer_id HAVING SUM(profit)<0 ORDER BY profit

title: Repeat Purchase Gaps
question: How long is the interval between consecutive distinct purchase dates?
sql: WITH dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id,order_date FROM superstore), a AS (SELECT *,LAG(order_date) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date) AS prior_date FROM dates) SELECT *,julianday(order_date)-julianday(prior_date) AS gap_days FROM a WHERE prior_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY customer_id,order_date

title: Power BI Executive Profit Scorecard
question: Which region-category combinations drive profit?
sql: SELECT region,category,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit,COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM superstore GROUP BY region,category ORDER BY profit DESC

title: Power BI Time Intelligence
question: How do annual metrics and comparable prior-year growth behave?
sql: SELECT order_year,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit,COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM superstore GROUP BY order_year ORDER BY order_year

title: Power BI Product Profit Matrix
question: Where does product revenue coexist with negative profitability?
sql: SELECT category,sub_category,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit,SUM(profit)/SUM(sales) AS margin FROM superstore GROUP BY category,sub_category ORDER BY profit

title: Power BI Discount Exposure
question: Which region-discount combinations show loss exposure?
sql: SELECT region,discount_band,COUNT(*) AS lines,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit,1.0*SUM(loss_flag)/COUNT(*) AS loss_line_rate FROM superstore GROUP BY region,discount_band ORDER BY region,discount_band

title: Power BI Customer Portfolio
question: Which region-segment combinations create customer value?
sql: SELECT region,segment,COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit FROM superstore GROUP BY region,segment ORDER BY sales DESC

title: Power BI Shipping Mix
question: How do order volume and dispatch intervals differ by region and mode?
sql: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id,region,ship_mode,MAX(ship_days) AS days FROM superstore GROUP BY order_id,region,ship_mode) SELECT region,ship_mode,COUNT(*) AS orders,AVG(days) AS mean_ship_days FROM o GROUP BY region,ship_mode ORDER BY region,mean_ship_days

title: Tableau City Profit Explorer
question: Which city-state combinations generate the strongest and weakest profits?
sql: SELECT city,state,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit FROM superstore GROUP BY city,state ORDER BY profit

title: Tableau Seasonal Sales Heatmap
question: How do calendar months compare across years?
sql: SELECT order_year,substr(order_month,6,2) AS month_number,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit FROM superstore GROUP BY order_year,month_number ORDER BY order_year,month_number

title: Tableau Customer Profit Scatter
question: Which customers have high sales but weak profitability?
sql: SELECT customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit FROM superstore GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY sales DESC

title: Tableau Category Share Story
question: How does category sales mix change across years?
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_year,category,SUM(sales) AS sales FROM superstore GROUP BY order_year,category) SELECT *,sales/SUM(sales) OVER(PARTITION BY order_year) AS annual_share FROM a ORDER BY order_year,category

title: Tableau Discount Loss Heatmap
question: Which subcategory-discount cells merit margin investigation?
sql: SELECT sub_category,discount_band,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit,1.0*SUM(loss_flag)/COUNT(*) AS loss_line_rate FROM superstore GROUP BY sub_category,discount_band ORDER BY sub_category,discount_band

title: Tableau Order Size Distribution
question: How does order size relate to order-level profit by quantity band?
sql: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(quantity) AS units,SUM(sales) AS sales,SUM(profit) AS profit FROM superstore GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN units<=5 THEN '01: 1-5 units' WHEN units<=10 THEN '02: 6-10 units' WHEN units<=20 THEN '03: 11-20 units' ELSE '04: 21+ units' END AS size_band FROM o) SELECT size_band,COUNT(*) AS orders,AVG(sales) AS average_order_sales,SUM(profit) AS profit FROM b GROUP BY size_band ORDER BY size_band
